name: Pedn
tagline: Soil intelligence for the enterprise land portfolio.
positioning: Pedn turns raw core samples and remote sensing into audit-ready soil data — one system of record for agronomy, carbon, and land compliance teams.

hero.h1: The system of record for enterprise soil data
hero.sub: Consolidate lab cores, spectral scans, and field observations into one governed dataset — so agronomy, carbon, and compliance teams stop reconciling spreadsheets and start trusting the same numbers.

features.title: Unified core-to-map pipeline
features.description: Ingest lab results, NIR spectra, and geotagged samples, then resolve them to a single validated soil horizon model across every field and parcel you manage.

features.title: Audit-ready carbon accounting
features.description: Generate SOC baselines and change reports aligned to Verra and CDR methodologies, with full sample lineage regulators and buyers can trace.

features.title: Portfolio-scale geospatial analytics
features.description: Benchmark nutrient, pH, and organic-matter trends across millions of hectares, with variance flags surfaced before they reach the field agronomist.

features.title: Lab and instrument integrations
features.description: Connect accredited labs and in-field spectrometers through validated connectors, eliminating manual CSV handoffs and transcription error.

features.title: Governed roles and approvals
features.description: SSO, granular permissions, and immutable change logs give data stewards control over who edits soil records and what gets published downstream.

features.title: Real-time sampling logistics
features.description: Track chain of custody from probe to result, with SLA alerts when samples stall in transit or lab turnaround slips past target.

testimonials.quote: Before Pedn, our carbon verification pack was six analysts and three weeks of spreadsheet reconciliation. Now the sample lineage is intact and the report exports in an afternoon.
testimonials.name: Marta Ellsworth

testimonials.quote: We manage soil data across 1.4 million hectares. Pedn is the first platform that gave our agronomists and compliance team a single defensible number to stand behind.
testimonials.name: David Okonkwo

testimonials.quote: The chain-of-custody tracking alone paid for the contract. We caught two lab turnaround failures in the first month that would have blown our sampling window.
testimonials.name: Priya Raman
